name: pq-tracker-local
description: Personal local marketplace exposing the pq-tracker plugin to Cowork. Reads the plugin straight from ./pq-plugin so edits to skills/tools take effect on reload.

plugins.name: pq-tracker
plugins.description: Search and analyse the local pq-tracker corpus of Irish health-related parliamentary questions. Exposes the read-only /api/v1 endpoints as agent tools and ships a research skill for combining PQ data with other sources.
